title: an object or list sent to a string-typed variable is refused, not stringified
note: run.py cannot compare two steps' answers, so run_workflow's 'the same two errors' is asserted by pinning today's two messages whole in steps 1 and 2. Step 2 sends acknowledged_cost=true as the prose does: if the refusal ever regresses, this step queues a real GPU job.

steps.label: step 1: an object and a list are each refused at their argument path

any_contains: Cannot convert variable 'first_image' value {'location': 'asset:qa-cast/priya-portrait.jpg'} to type str: this variable takes a plain string (a URL, or an 'asset:'/'output:' reference), not an object
Cannot convert variable 'last_image' value ['asset:qa-cast/hal-portrait.jpg'] to type str: this variable takes a plain string (a URL, or an 'asset:'/'output:' reference), not an object
